script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

TITLE: LIGHTS OUT

FADE IN:

EXT. CITYSCAPE - NIGHT

The neon lights of a bustling metropolis pulse and glow, casting an otherworldly sheen on the crowd below.

INT. TECH LAB - DAY

JOHN (35, tech genius) sits in a dimly lit lab, surrounded by circuit boards and wires. He works diligently on a holographic projector, muttering to himself.

JOHN
(whispering to himself)
This is it... The future of communication...

INT. JOHN'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

John's apartment is a mess. Empty takeout containers and stacks of unwashed dishes clutter the countertops. John sits at his computer, staring at a job application.

JOHN
(to himself)
I can't keep doing this...

Suddenly, the power goes out. The room is plunged into darkness.

INT. STREETS - NIGHT

The city is thrown into chaos as the power grid fails. Panicked citizens flood the streets, seeking answers.

INT. TECH LAB - DARK

John, determined, grabs a flashlight and heads to the lab. He arrives to find the holographic projector humming and emitting a faint glow.

JOHN
(exultant)
I've done it...

EXT. CITY SQUARE - DAY

The city square is filled with people, seeking information and aid. A small crowd gathers around John's holographic projector, amazed by its power.

JOHN
(to the crowd)
I've developed a way to keep our city connected, even without power. I'll need volunteers to help me set it up citywide.

INT. TECH LAB - NIGHT

John and his team work tirelessly to set up the holographic communication system. They install projectors on rooftops and in public spaces.

INT. JOHN'S APARTMENT - DAY

John returns home, exhausted but triumphant. He looks at the pile of unpaid bills and job applications on the counter, then smiles.

JOHN
(to himself)
This is my chance...

INT. INVESTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

John presents his holographic communication system to a group of investors. They are skeptical at first, but John's passion and determination convince them to invest.

INT. TECH LAB - NIGHT

John and his team work around the clock to bring the holographic communication system to fruition. The city is slowly brought back to life, and John's name becomes synonymous with innovation.

INT. JOHN'S APARTMENT - DAY

John sits at his computer, a stack of thank-you notes from the city's residents piled high. He smiles as he reads a job offer from a prestigious tech company.

JOHN
(to himself)
This is just the beginning...

FADE OUT.

THE END
